definitions.short: the Arnon , a river east of the Jordan, also its territory
definitions.full: H769. Arnon אַרְנֹן אַרְנוֺן, proper name, of a river Arnon , wady & stream in Moab (MI ארנן , Thes Add Rob Ges MV derive from רנן , i.e. the rushing, roaring stream) — אַרְנוֺן Num 21:13 (twice in verse) + 12 t., אַרְנֹן 21:14 10 t. — called boundary between Moab & Amorites 21:13 ; Judg 11:18 , 22 compare גְּבוּלאַרְנֹן Num 22:36 ; often אֵרְנֹן נַחַל Deut 2:24 , 36 ; 3:8 , 12 , 16 ; 4:48 ; 2Kin 10:33 ; ׳נ אַרְנוֺן Josh 12:1-2 , 13:9 , 16 ; אַרְנוֺן הַנְּחָלִים Num 21:14 , i.e. the stream-ravines that unite to form Arnon, compare Di; also אַרְנֹן בָּמוֺת heights of Arnon 21:28 ; אַרְנוֺן מעברות fords of Arnon Isa 16:2 ; elsewhere Num 21:13 , 24 , 26 ; Judg 11:13 , 18 , 26 ; synonym of Moab Jer 48:20 ; (compare Tristr Moab 125 f. ; modern Môjib ). II. ארן (√ assumed for following word, compare Sta § 208 c ; Dl Pr 125 argues for √ ארה (so Thes), on ground of an Assyrian êrû , synonym of êrênu ).
definitions.rootNote: or אַרְנֹן lemma אַרְנן missing vowel, corrected to אַרְנֹן ; from 7442 ; a brawling stream;
